cues.text: Welcome to the circuits lab. You will build circuits on a breadboard and find out how current, voltage and resistance work together. Predict first, then watch what really happens.
First, Ohm's law. Change the voltage and the resistance, and watch the ammeter and the graph. Predict each reading before you run it.
Now series and parallel. Wire two bulbs each way and compare them with a single bulb. Predict what you will see first.
The fuse bench. Raise the voltage slowly and watch the thin wire. Predict what will happen before you do.
Prediction locked. Now run it and see what really happens.
That is not what you predicted, and that is fine. Surprises are where the learning happens. Think about why.
That is every question on every bench. Open your summary to see how your predictions and explanations went.
